displayName: AdKit for LinkedIn Ads: Campaign Groups, Campaigns, Ads, Targeting and Reporting
description: Create, edit, and report on LinkedIn ads from an AI agent through the AdKit MCP connector: campaign groups, campaigns, ads, targeting search, media upload, and results. Every change is saved as a draft that the user approves before it goes live. Use when the user wants to run, change, or check LinkedIn ads. Not for LinkedIn ad strategy or creative advice.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
